# Algorithm fixtures

generated-colors.png was produced with Python standard-library PNG/zlib encoding: 64×32 pixels, left half red and right half blue. generated-colors.heic was encoded from it with macOS `sips -s format heic generated-colors.png --out generated-colors.heic` on 2026-10-07. Created for this project, CC0. Neither is a garment-quality acceptance sample.

Recognition public fixtures: `Zapato.jpg` (Antonio Páramo, public domain) and `Jeans.jpg` (Oktaeder, public domain). Adjacent LICENSE.md files preserve authoritative Commons attribution and download URLs. Used with the existing CC BY-SA4.0 OKM shirt for actual local vision inference; none are user photos. No fixture filename or expected category enters the model prompt or taxonomy normalizer.
